mapper.select:
SELECT t.id, t.team_code, t.team_name, t.department_code, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.deleted_at, t.delete_flag, e.id AS emp_id, e.client_id, e.user_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.system_role, e.image_url, e.salary, e.created_at AS emp_created_at, e.updated_at AS emp_updated_at, e.deleted_at AS emp_deleted_at, e.delete_flag AS emp_delete_flag FROM teams t
WHERE t.team_code = #{teamCode} AND t.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teams (team_code, team_name, department_code, created_at, updated_at, delete_flag) VALUES (#{team.teamCode}, #{team.teamName}, #{team.departmentCode}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value})
mapper.update: UPDATE teams SET delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@DELETED.value}, deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{teamCode}
